items.summary: Disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta/full launch and any rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot documentation proves API access but not public display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate, advertising, image, price, or trademark rights; public terms restrict product-data collection and derivative use. Human counsel is required before any permission request or rights-dependent launch decision. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown; incomplete telemetry is not itself a blocker. Revenue remains $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 under an unattributed provider row; no site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift is supported. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep outreach unsent, and continue only existing evidence work.

Tracking remains active. No task is closed because current evidence does not establish complete rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4, vendor, or incident controls. Progress: official Woot documentation, public terms/support records, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms are attached. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data flow and retention, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence. Do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, launch state, or send outreach.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. Missing current written permission/API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, image/price/trademark terms, and affiliate/advertising rights. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent/withdrawal capture, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture configuration and consent evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce the read-only log/vendor/incident inventory.

Retain complicated.work parked and blocked: compliance reachability is unknown and analytics is not configured; do not launch until a concrete site decision and checklist evidence exist. Retain deadlymaracas.com parked/private: DNS/compliance reachability is unknown and analytics is not configured; next action is the already-open bounded readiness assessment, not launch. broadwayshowgirls.com is live but the latest compliance check is unreachable, so do not treat it as cleared. deeppenetrations.com is live with GA4/GSC health recorded, but the latest compliance check is unreachable; preserve existing disclosures and claims boundaries and do not infer age-sensitive status from the name. Across the fleet, triage affiliate disclosures, cookie/analytics disclosure and consent, privacy/terms, claims substantiation, data provenance/rights, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and regulated or age-sensitive concerns site-by-site; no fleet-wide legal clearance is supported.
